name: Ojai Valley Inn & Spa
positioning: Spanish revival resort on 220 acres in California's Ojai Valley, with a 30,000-square-foot spa, an 18-hole golf course and views of the Topatopa Mountains
best_for: Spa and wellness weekends built around Spa Ojai and its two spa pools
Couples wanting rooms with private fireplaces or fire pits
Families using Camp Oak and the family-friendly Pixie Pool
Golfers and outdoor lovers interested in the resort course, horseback rides and jeep tours

facts.text: The hotel is at 905 Country Club Road in Ojai, California.
The resort spans 220 acres, with organic herb gardens growing 65 culinary and medicinal herbs.
Conde Nast Traveler describes a sprawling Spanish revival hotel with towering oak trees and running fountains.
The Wallace Neff Estate Rooms are named for the original guestroom building created by architect Wallace Neff.
Fireside Terrace Rooms have a terrace with seating around a private gas-burning stone fire pit.
The Moonrise Penthouse, atop Spa Ojai, has an outdoor terrace with views of the Topatopa Mountains.
The Paseo Villas sit beside the Spa Village and are surrounded by a rose garden courtyard.
The Tranquility Pool and Energy Pool are located at Spa Ojai.
Guided horseback rides through the valley take in views of the Topatopa mountain range.
Complimentary daily fitness and wellness classes include yoga, meditation and spinning.
Camp Oak offers daily theme-based programming for children ages 4 to 12.
Hands-on cooking classes are held at The Farmhouse using locally grown ingredients.

highlights.text: Filmmaker Frank Capra used Ojai to represent Shangri-La in his film Lost Horizon.
Spa Ojai is a 30,000-square-foot spa focused on natural and organic beauty and wellness practices.
Pools include the family-friendly Pixie Pool with pool games and the Indigo Pool & Bar, reserved for adults.
A resident beekeeper leads visits inside a working hive, ending with a tasting of cold-pressed raw honey.
The resort's 18-hole golf course plays 6,292 yards at par 70.

considerations.text: Wallace Neff Estate Rooms do not have bathtubs.
Penthouses are for guests without pets; pets are welcome in a variety of other room categories.
Camp Oak requires registration 24 hours in advance.
